notes: Tuition: the page fr-i-u-t-de-villetaneuse shows only a general institution-wide figure for Parcoursup candidates (178 euros par annee, i.e. the EU/EEA/first-time-licence fee); the Campus France Maroc page (le cout des etudes, les bourses) states the differentiated rate for Moroccan/extra-community students in a Licence cycle, which is what the 'differenced rights' fact records (2902 EUR). No programme-specific amount is stated. Duration: the Parcoursup page states 6 semesters; the BUT is normally a 3-year (bac+3) diplome, but only the semester count was quoted. Intake: no dated non-EU application deadline is stated; the only dated window quoted (ADIUT Maroc, 1er octobre au 15 novembre 2026) belongs to the BUT 1re annee ADIUT Maroc procedure, not to this Paris-Nord IUT programme, so no intake is included. applicationChannel omitted as instructed (foreign-diploma applicants go through Etudes en France / Campus France). Documents: no document list is stated on these pages, so no documents are included.
